About us

An entrance automation contractor, not a reseller

Smart Parking Solutions supplies, installs and maintains gate automation, access barriers and mechanised parking systems for clients who need the entrance to work every single day.

Who we are

We began with gate automation and grew into a full entrance and parking practice — sliding and swing gate operators, sensor glass doors, boom barriers and stack parking systems. Every job is executed by our own engineers, from the first site measurement to the handover training.

That single-contractor model is why security establishments, embassies and industrial groups keep us on their approved lists: one team is accountable for the drawing, the civil work, the electricals, the commissioning and the maintenance that follows.

Mission

Entrances that open reliably, close safely and never become the reason a site stops working.

Vision

To be the default automation contractor for secured and institutional premises in North India.

What we bring to a site

Own installation crew

Trained fitters and electricians on our rolls — nothing handed to a labour contractor.

Fabrication capability

Gate frames, rails, foundations and guide posts made to the surveyed dimensions.

Spares in stock

Controllers, sensors, gear racks and boom sets held so a breakdown does not wait on an order.

Clearance experience

Familiar with the documentation and access protocol of secured government premises.

Integration know-how

Barriers and doors tied into existing access control, RFID, ANPR and ticketing.

Documented handover

Drawings, warranty papers, operating instructions and staff training on completion.

Common questions

Can you automate a gate we already have?

In most cases yes. We check the frame, wheels, rail and alignment during the survey and quote for any civil or fabrication correction needed before fitting the operator.

What happens during a power cut?

Every system ships with a manual release key, and battery or UPS backup can be specified so the gate keeps operating through an outage.

How long does installation take?

A boom barrier or swing gate is usually commissioned in a day. Sliding gates and stack parking depend on civil work and are scheduled after the drawing is approved.

Do you work inside secured premises?

Yes. We regularly execute work at police headquarters, embassies and government estates, and follow the site's clearance, documentation and access procedures.

Is maintenance included?

Warranty covers the supplied equipment. Beyond that we offer comprehensive or labour-only AMC with scheduled visits and priority breakdown attendance.
